title: Fed Notes - How high might they go

classification.rationale: The note uses a Taylor rule with alternative r-star scenarios to assess how high the Fed's tightening cycle could go, and finds about 40bps of upside risk to the baseline terminal rate.
classification.runner_up_reason: It follows up on the September FOMC and Warsh's press conference, but its main purpose is the terminal rate analysis rather than a meeting recap.
